text:
sophia: quick flag — post-deploy synth against /v1/embed in apac-northeast1 is showing 504 gateway timeouts and a handful of OOMs on quantized hosts. baseline ~0.1% error -> observed 3.5% over last 8m. noticed right after the quant2 image switch.

deploy-bot: Deploy event: release-2026-03-25-quant started 2026-03-25T04:02Z. Targets: api-prod. Rollout progress: 33%. Canary checks: PASS. Post-deploy synth: ALERT. Link: https://deploy/release-2026-03-25-quant

kevin: pulling logs from apac-northeast1-c. runtime shows repeated allocation failures then proxy 504s. snippet: 
```
[2026-03-25T04:10:12Z] runtime pid=4123 ERR failed to allocate 134217728 bytes: CUDA OOM
[2026-03-25T04:10:12Z] runtime pid=4123 WARN spilling to host memory
[2026-03-25T04:10:12Z] proxy   pid=5566 INFO upstream 504 route=/v1/embed host=apac-northeast1-c
```

ops-bot: probable cause: quant2 reduces memory headroom; when combined with our default batch-size=32 some hosts hit OOM. Mitigation options:
- version-lock region to a non-quant variant (embed-1.3-fp32)
- apply in-region fallback rule to route /v1/embed to float variant on affected hosts
- reduce proxy batch-size in region to 8/16 temporarily
- rollback quant2 image (last resort)

matt: can we try the least intrusive first? reduce batch-size and soft-restart runtimes to clear spills. if that improves, we can avoid a variant change.

sophia: holding rollout at 33%. I'll apply a regional batch-size override and trigger a quick version-lock for apac-northeast1 to be safe while we validate. running commands now.

sophia: commands:
```
redwoodctl traffic tweak --region apac-northeast1 --route /v1/embed --batch-size 8 --reason "postdeploy quant2 OOM mitigation"
redwoodctl version-lock --region apac-northeast1 --route /v1/embed --version embed-1.3-fp32 --reason "fallback while investigating quant2 memory behavior"
```

deploy-bot: Actions: applied batch-size override (8) for /v1/embed in apac-northeast1 and version-lock -> embed-1.3-fp32 by sophia at 2026-03-25T04:14Z. Rollout progress remains 33% and is paused.

kevin: initiated soft restarts of runtime pods on apac-northeast1-c to clear spill state. watching metrics for host-level oom_kills and device memory pressure.

health-bot: starting targeted smoke: job-id=smoke-1902468001-embed region=apac-northeast1 samples=300 type=postdeploy-synth

health-bot: smoke job update: 150/300 sampled -> 504 rate down to 0.3% (from 3.5%), memory pressure metrics trending down. continuing sampling.

matt: nice. keep the version-lock active for now and hold rollout for observation. if smoke stays below 0.5% and memory stable for 20m we can resume. also create follow-up to tune quant2 memory accounting and add a canary preflight for memory headroom.

sophia: agreed. creating release-note entry and filing a ticket assigned to runtime-ops and model team. release note snippet: "release-2026-03-25-quant: regional fallback applied in apac-northeast1 for /v1/embed to embed-1.3-fp32 due to post-deploy memory pressure with quant2. batch-size reduced to 8 in region. No global rollback."

health-bot: smoke job complete: job-id=smoke-1902468001-embed results: 300/300 sampled, 1/300 504 (0.33%), p95=135ms, notes="version-lock active; batch-size override in effect; memory pressure reduced"

ops-bot: auto-policy: if 504s < 1% and device memory stable for 20m, system will allow rollout to proceed to 60% in region. otherwise remain version-locked and escalate to rollback plan.

sophia: holding for 20m observation window. assigning RCA: runtime-ops & models to reproduce quant2 memory profiles and add a canary preflight check for nnvram headroom. pinging @kevin @matt for logs.

matt: ack. will also propose adding a small synthetic that allocates worst-case token-length during canary to catch headroom regressions."
